title: Extract PDF Pages – Save Selected Pages Free, No Upload
description: Extract pages from a PDF in your browser: click the pages you want and save them as a new PDF, or one PDF per page. Free, and nothing is uploaded.
heading: Extract pages from a PDF
subtitle: Click the pages you want and save them as a new PDF; nothing is uploaded.

features.title: Private
features.text: Your file is handled by your own browser and never sent to a server, so nobody else sees it.

features.title: Pick by clicking
features.text: Click the thumbnails of the pages to keep; Shift+click picks a run of pages.

features.title: Works offline
features.text: Once this page has loaded, the tool keeps working without an internet connection.

steps.title: Choose your PDF
steps.text: Click Choose a file, or drop a PDF on the page. Its pages appear as thumbnails.

steps.title: Select the pages to keep
steps.text: Click each page you want. Tick One PDF per page to get each page as its own file.

steps.title: Extract and download
steps.text: Click Extract pages, check the preview and download the PDF or the ZIP.

limits: PDFs that need a password to open can't be read; remove the password first.
Pages keep the order they have in the original PDF.
Bookmarks of the original PDF are not carried over.

faq.question: Is my file uploaded?
faq.answer: No. Your file is read and changed by your own browser, on your device, and is never sent anywhere. You can check it: open your browser's network panel while you use the tool and you will see no upload.

faq.question: Can I get each page as its own file?
faq.answer: Yes. Tick One PDF per page and the pages come as separate PDFs in one ZIP.

faq.question: Will the quality change?
faq.answer: No. Pages are copied as they are, so text stays sharp and selectable.

faq.question: Can I use a password-protected PDF?
faq.answer: Not yet. A PDF that needs a password to open can't be read here. Remove the password in the app you use to open it, then try again.

faq.question: Is it really free?
faq.answer: Yes. There is no account, no watermark and no limit on how often you use it.
